question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's consolidated authority within the Chinese Communist Party, including a purged military leadership and absence of any designated successor, underpins trader consensus that he will remain in power through the end of 2026. Recent closed-door preparations at Beidaihe and signals ahead of the October 2026 plenum on party governance point to continuity rather than transition, with expectations centered on a fourth term at the 2021 Party Congress in 2027. No public health concerns or elite divisions have surfaced to alter this outlook. Scenarios that could still shift probabilities include a sudden medical event, severe economic pressures prompting internal reevaluation, or an unforeseen leadership challenge, though these remain low-probability events based on current verifiable developments.
